worldcombat.skill.accelerock.summary: Clad in shattered rock, the user smashes along the ground into the target: a landed hit sends it flying and cracks a small rubble scar into the ground. The heaviest first strike in its family. The breakthrough form instead plows straight through a line.
worldcombat.skill.accelerock.use.0: The heaviest grounded first strike, launching the target
worldcombat.skill.accelerock.use.1: Plow through a line of enemies with the breakthrough form
worldcombat.skill.accelerock.use.2: Crack a rubble scar into the ground at the impact
worldcombat.skill.accelerock.description: The rock-clad body deals about %1$s contact damage with a %2$s block hit radius; the target's Defence, type match-up and criticals settle on impact.
It charges up to %1$s blocks, advancing %2$s blocks per tick, and shoves the target about %3$s blocks along the charge.
The charge can plow through up to %1$s target(s) along its path.
The impact cracks out a rubble scar about %1$s blocks in radius, turning the ground to rock; the original blocks return after about %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.accelerock.breakthroug: Breakthrough: plow through up to %1$s targets along the charge, cracking a rubble scar at each impact, at the cost of lighter hits, less shove, slower preparation and recovery and a longer cooldown.
Standard: stop at the first target with the heaviest hit, the longest shove and the fastest recovery.
worldcombat.skill.accelerock.timing: Charge within %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.accelerock.growth.0: At level %1$s the impact rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.accelerock.growth.1: At level %1$s the impact rises to %2$s and the charge to %3$s.
On: plow through up to 2 targets (3 when very fast), leaving a rubble scar at each impact, at the cost of 0.85x damage per hit, 0.7x shove, +2 ticks preparation, +3 ticks recovery and +6 ticks cooldown. Off: stop at the first target with the heaviest hit and the longest shove.
It charges only at targets within this distance; the charge is medium range, so larger values often still mean walking in first.
On: below three tenths health the target is finished with this charge; off: it ranks as an ordinary first-strike candidate.
